name: Doomsday Prepper
description: Survives by preparing for catastrophes that may never come
behavioral_signature: Has a plan for every apocalypse scenario including the unlikely ones
under_stress: Finally vindicated when disaster strikes, becomes smugly competent
at_rest: Stockpiling, planning, and warning others who don't listen
will_never: be caught without a contingency plan
unless: the disaster is something genuinely unprecedented
